newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-STURM GRAZ WIN AUSTRIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STURM GRAZ WIN AUSTRIAN CUP.

text.p: Sturm Graz beat FC Vienna 2-1 (halftime 1-0) in the final of the Austrian Cup on Tuesday.
Sturm Graz - Ivica Vastic 5 penalty, Jens Dowe 74
FC Vienna - Mario Posch 87 own goal

Sturm Graz - Kazimierz Sidorczuk, Martin Hidden, Darko Milanic, Mario Posch, Wolfgang Hopfer, Marek Swierczewski, Roman Maehlich, Jens Dowe, Marcus Puerk (Gilbert Prilasnig 65), Hannes Reinmayer (Mario Haas 87), Ivica Vastic

FC Vienna - Heinz Weber, Franz Blizenec, Christoph Jank, Alexander Jank, Andreas Gutlederer, Manfred Wachter (Manfred Preschern 82), Peter Pospisil, Hans Slunecko, Martin Lang, Michael Strasser (Martin Cestnik 65), Zeljko Radovic
